packageRules.description: cove-base-image and cove-base are built locally in this repo (not pulled from a registry), so Renovate must not try to update those FROM lines.

Node stays on the 22.x LTS line. NODE_VERSION (the exact pin) and NODE_MAJOR_VERSION (the nodesource channel) are coupled, but Renovate only bumps NODE_VERSION — a major jump would leave the channel behind and fail the build. Pin to <23; move the ceiling deliberately (and bump NODE_MAJOR_VERSION with it) to change majors.
Stay on Ubuntu 24.04 LTS: refresh the pinned base digest, but don't jump the distro version (Renovate offered 26.04). Digest updates keep the 24.04 tag and stay enabled; a version bump is deliberate.

customManagers.description: Go toolchain — GO_VERSION arg in the cove-image Dockerfile
hadolint — HADOLINT_VERSION arg in the cove-image Dockerfile
Eclipse Temurin JDK — JDK_RELEASE arg (captures the version after the jdk- prefix)
Node.js — NODE_VERSION arg (nodesource deb; track the upstream node version, keep the -1nodesourceN suffix)
